categories.label: Actions
categories.description: Buttons and interactive controls that trigger an operation or navigate.

categories.label: Navigation
categories.description: Components that help users move between pages, sections, or states.

categories.label: Data Entry
categories.description: Form controls that capture user input.

categories.label: Selection & Controls
categories.description: Controls for choosing values, navigating ranges, or toggling options.

categories.label: Data Display
categories.description: Read-only components that present information or status.

categories.label: Feedback & Overlays
categories.description: Components that communicate system state or require user acknowledgment.

categories.label: Content Layout
categories.description: Structural components that arrange and present content sections.

categories.label: Product
categories.description: Commerce-specific compositions for displaying and selling products.

codeComponents.name: Button
codeComponents.description: Standard labelled action button covering primary, secondary, tertiary, and stateful variants.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual hierarchy — never use color/appearance words. primary/secondary are implemented; tertiary and stateful are proposed.

props.name: scale
props.description: Size — always a separate prop, never encoded in variant

codeComponents.justification: All <button> elements with text labels; variant prop handles visual hierarchy

codeComponents.name: IconButton
codeComponents.description: Icon-only button with no visible label. Requires an aria-label. Covers close, play, floating action, expand-collapse, increment/decrement, and navigation variants.

props.name: variant
props.description: Distinguishes the Figma source frame within one component. Values are proposed — derived from Figma frame names, not a Figma axis.

codeComponents.justification: All icon-only <button> elements; unified by absence of text label (MUI/Radix convention)

codeComponents.name: LinkButton
codeComponents.description: Inline anchor link with an optional leading or trailing icon. Always renders as an <a> element and requires an href.

props.name: href
props.description: Required. The URL the link points to.

props.name: variant
props.description: Distinguishes a plain text link from a directional/arrow-style link. Values are proposed — not derived from a Figma axis.

props.name: iconPosition
props.description: Leading = icon left, trailing = icon right

codeComponents.justification: Both render as <a> with inline text + icon; icon position is the only layout axis

codeComponents.name: Input
codeComponents.description: Single-line text entry field covering all text, date, password, and search variants.
codeComponents.justification: All single-line <input> elements; HTML type attribute distinguishes text, date, password, and search variants

codeComponents.name: Textarea
codeComponents.description: Multi-line text entry field.
codeComponents.justification: Single <textarea> element; no grouping needed

codeComponents.name: FieldGroup
codeComponents.description: Groups related form fields in a horizontal row. Renders as <fieldset> + <legend> for accessible field grouping.

props.name: columns
props.description: Number of equal-width columns. Figma shows the 2-column pattern.

codeComponents.justification: Both are <fieldset> wrappers grouping related form fields (WCAG 1.3.1 info and relationships)

codeComponents.name: Select
codeComponents.description: Dropdown select control. Covers both inline and form-embedded variants.

props.name: variant
props.description: Use form for label+border style in a form context

codeComponents.justification: All <select> dropdown elements; Form Dropdown adds label + border for form context

codeComponents.name: Checkbox
codeComponents.description: Boolean checkbox input with label. Also covers the single-consent / long-text checkbox pattern.
codeComponents.justification: Both are input[type=checkbox] with label; Single Select Box is a long-text usage pattern of the same element

codeComponents.name: RadioButton
codeComponents.description: Single radio option — used inside a RadioGroup.
codeComponents.justification: Single input[type=radio] element; error state belongs to parent RadioGroup

codeComponents.name: Switch
codeComponents.description: On/off switch control, optionally with a text label.
codeComponents.justification: Both are role="switch" controls; Toggle with Text is the same switch plus an inline text label

codeComponents.name: ToggleGroup
codeComponents.description: Segmented control for mutually exclusive selection between 2-3 options. Implement with @radix-ui/react-toggle-group.
codeComponents.justification: Segmented control for mutually exclusive option selection; Radix ToggleGroup provides ARIA and keyboard nav

codeComponents.name: Slider
codeComponents.description: Range input slider for selecting a numeric value.
codeComponents.justification: Single input[type=range] element with a numeric value display

codeComponents.name: Badge
codeComponents.description: Small inline label for tags, status indicators, and countdown timers.

props.name: variant
props.description: Use semantic variants (success/warning/error) not color words

codeComponents.justification: Inline promotional pills and countdown timers share the same compact <span> display pattern

codeComponents.name: SaleCallout
codeComponents.description: Large promotional display text showing a percentage discount headline (e.g. "Save up to 75%").
codeComponents.justification: Large display-heading promotional text; visually and structurally distinct from small inline Badge elements

codeComponents.name: StarRating
codeComponents.description: Star icon for ratings, with optional count display.
codeComponents.justification: Star is the atomic icon unit; Reviews is the full rating row — one component renders both

codeComponents.name: PriceLabel
codeComponents.description: Price display with optional original/sale price.
codeComponents.justification: Single price display element; sale/value/subscription are all formatting variants of the same data

codeComponents.name: Breadcrumbs
codeComponents.description: Hierarchical page location indicator.
codeComponents.justification: Single <nav> breadcrumb trail

codeComponents.name: Menu
codeComponents.description: Navigation menu — simple text links or button-style items.
codeComponents.justification: Both are dropdown menu triggers; simple = text links, button = pill-shaped — same interaction, different visual treatment

codeComponents.name: Tabs
codeComponents.description: Tab bar for switching between content panels. Covers container and individual tab item.

props.name: variant
props.description: container is the full tab bar; item is a single tab

codeComponents.justification: Container and individual tab item are inseparable parts of one Radix Tabs primitive

codeComponents.name: SubnavDropdown
codeComponents.description: Sub-navigation dropdown with trigger and option list.
codeComponents.justification: Trigger and options list are parts of one dropdown navigation; both required for the full interaction

codeComponents.name: QuantityInput
codeComponents.description: Numeric quantity picker with increment and decrement buttons.
codeComponents.justification: Single +/- quantity picker control; split from AddToCart which is a higher-level composition

codeComponents.name: AddToCart
codeComponents.description: Multi-stage add-to-cart widget: CTA button → quantity picker → in-cart confirmation. Deferred — not planned for initial implementation.
codeComponents.justification: Multi-stage add-to-cart flow (CTA → quantity picker → in-cart confirmation); deferred pending design finalization

codeComponents.name: Pagination
codeComponents.description: Navigation controls for paging through content.
codeComponents.justification: All three provide content navigation controls; arrow buttons, dot selector, and scroll bar are layout variants of the same <nav>

codeComponents.name: Toast
codeComponents.description: Transient status notification bar. Implement with @radix-ui/react-toast; role="status" for info/success, role="alert" for warning/error.
codeComponents.justification: Single notification bar; dynamic ARIA role per severity (Radix Toast)

codeComponents.name: Modal
codeComponents.description: Dialog overlay with header, body, and action group. Content areas use BuilderBlocks.
codeComponents.justification: Dialog content and footer button row are inseparable parts of one <dialog> element (Radix Dialog)

codeComponents.name: Accordion
codeComponents.description: Expandable/collapsible section with header and body content.
codeComponents.justification: Single expandable <details> section with title trigger and body content (Radix Accordion)

codeComponents.name: EmailCapture
codeComponents.description: Email address input with inline submit action.
codeComponents.justification: Single inline email <form> with embedded submit action; too coupled to split

codeComponents.name: FileUpload
codeComponents.description: Drag-and-drop / click-to-browse file upload area.
codeComponents.justification: Single drag-and-drop / click-to-browse file upload zone

codeComponents.name: RadioGroup
codeComponents.description: Group of mutually exclusive radio options with field label and error state. Implement with @radix-ui/react-radio-group.

props.name: variant
props.description: list = vertical with field label (Multi-Selector), inline = compact horizontal pills (Multi-Select with Text)

codeComponents.justification: Both show grouped radio options with fieldset wrapper; list vs inline are layout variants (Radix RadioGroup)

codeComponents.name: CheckboxGroup
codeComponents.description: Group of multi-select checkbox options with field label and error state.

props.name: variant
props.description: list = vertical with field label, inline = compact horizontal pills

codeComponents.justification: All show grouped checkbox options in a fieldset; Single Select Box is a single-item consent group

codeComponents.name: ButtonGroup
codeComponents.description: Horizontal or vertical group of Button components for related actions.
codeComponents.justification: Both group related action buttons; CTA Row is the full-width stacked variant

codeComponents.name: Chip
codeComponents.description: Filter chip wrapping Button with constrained API: pill shape, icon + text label, selected/unselected states.
codeComponents.justification: Filter-chip pattern on top of Button; Category Button uses pill shape and icon+label API not shared by general Button (MUI Chip convention)

codeComponents.name: ProductCard
codeComponents.description: Grid-format product card with image, title, price, reviews, and actions.
codeComponents.justification: Single grid product card — badge, image, title, rating, price, CTA

codeComponents.name: ProductDetail
codeComponents.description: Full product detail display with description, quantity picker, and purchase actions.
codeComponents.justification: Single full-detail product view; distinct from card (grid listing) and ProductLineup (hero showcase)

codeComponents.name: ProductLineup
codeComponents.description: Hero-style product showcase with blue image area, ownership badge, and purchase CTA. Three responsive variants (desktop/tablet/mobile).
codeComponents.justification: Hero product showcase with distinct layout and responsive variants; not a detail view or grid card

codeComponents.name: FreeTrialCard
codeComponents.description: Promotional card for free trial offers.
codeComponents.justification: Single pricing/trial card with plan name, price, CTA button, and feature checklist

codeComponents.name: SectionLayout
codeComponents.description: Page section with headline, body copy, and optional CTA slots. Content authors manage children via BuilderBlocks.
codeComponents.justification: All are <section> content blocks with a headline; variants progressively add CTA link, body copy, and button group

codeComponents.name: ProductCarousel
codeComponents.description: Horizontally scrollable carousel of ProductCard items backed by API data.
codeComponents.justification: Single horizontally scrolling product card container backed by API data

codeComponents.name: CtaList
codeComponents.description: Vertical list of CTA rows, each linking to a product or resource.
codeComponents.justification: Single vertical list of CTA link rows with arrow icons

codeComponents.name: BasicForm
codeComponents.description: Generic form with field layout managed via BuilderBlocks.
codeComponents.justification: Generic <form> shell with field layout managed entirely via Builder.io slot content

proposedFolderStructure: component.tsx   # React component — no Builder.io imports
